title: world share link/2
description: The payload a world share link carries, after js/shareState.js decodePayload() has read the fragment (#2z or #2r, then base64url of the, deflated or raw, JSON): the scenario by id (version 1 names it by its English name, which every reader still accepts and resolves), the seed that generated the world, the settings at generation (`d`) and the changes after it (`a`), the camera, the bodies of a full link, whether to open paused, the experiment extras (`x`, link-extras/1) and an A/B setup (`xp`, experiment-link-block/1). The reader refuses a fragment that is not a link, one from a newer version, one that is cut short, one that holds data it will not read, and a payload with no scenario or one this build does not have; unknown keys are ignored, which is what keeps an older build able to open a newer link. A scenario is checked against the built-in ids by the reader, not here. FORMATS.md lists it.
